AC-001.title: Request missing information first
AC-001.condition: The feedback cannot be linked to a delivery item or does not describe the desired change.
AC-001.pass_criteria: Retain feedback and attachments, identify a concrete gap, and do not infer effort.
AC-001.verification: Inspect the page and saved result for BR-001 and compare records before and after the action. This is a synthetic acceptance criterion, not an executed test result.

AC-002.title: Keep evidence for small changes
AC-002.condition: The change adds no scope and changes no delivery milestone, and the designer has recorded the basis.
AC-002.pass_criteria: The designer may handle it directly, retaining the assessment and outcome for the lead.
AC-002.verification: Inspect the page and saved result for BR-002 and compare records before and after the action. This is a synthetic acceptance criterion, not an executed test result.

AC-003.title: A lead confirms new commitments
AC-003.condition: The request adds scope or cost, or affects a delivery milestone.
AC-003.pass_criteria: Request lead confirmation; do not communicate a committed date until an explicit decision is saved.
AC-003.verification: Inspect the page and saved result for BR-003 and compare records before and after the action. This is a synthetic acceptance criterion, not an executed test result.

AC-004.title: Return is different from decline
AC-004.condition: The lead needs more evidence before deciding.
AC-004.pass_criteria: Retain the request, explain what is missing, and allow revision and resubmission.
AC-004.verification: Inspect the page and saved result for BR-004 and compare records before and after the action. This is a synthetic acceptance criterion, not an executed test result.

AC-005.title: Explain what a deferral awaits
AC-005.condition: The lead chooses to defer the request.
AC-005.pass_criteria: State the outstanding business decision and follow-up condition; do not present a deferral as a decline.
AC-005.verification: Inspect the page and saved result for BR-005 and compare records before and after the action. This is a synthetic acceptance criterion, not an executed test result.

AC-006.title: Separate saving from delivery
AC-006.condition: A decision is saved but the external notification service has not confirmed delivery.
AC-006.pass_criteria: Keep the decision valid, show failed delivery and allow retry without duplicating the decision.

AC-007.title: Explicitly adopt an AI draft
AC-007.condition: The assistant returns an impact explanation that has not been adopted.
AC-007.pass_criteria: Show an editable draft only; do not overwrite human explanations or change the decision status.
AC-007.verification: Inspect the page and saved result for BR-007 and compare records before and after the action. This is a synthetic acceptance criterion, not an executed test result.

AC-008.title: Review concurrent updates
AC-008.condition: Another member saves a newer version of the same decision during review.
AC-008.pass_criteria: Retain current input, show the conflict and latest content, and allow retry after review.

AC-009.title: Keep submission reachable on narrow screens

AC-009.pass_criteria: The explanation scrolls, actions do not cover text, and cancellation has a clear return path.
